preview: Jamaica Kingsmen face Antigua & Barbuda Falcons in CPL 2026 Match 1 at Arnos Vale Stadium. The match is scheduled for Fri 7 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. The Falcons bring Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph home for 2026 and add Evin Lewis to a returning core that includes Fabian Allen, Jayden Seales and Amir Jangoo. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
